title: Mexican Crumble Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, featuring a tender and crispy topping. Perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together bread crumbs, crumble cheese, cumin, salt, and chili powder.
Add oil and lime juice to the bowl and mix until crumbly.
Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add fermented salsa and cook until warmed through.
Add tender corn to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Spoon the corn mixture onto a baking dish.
Top with the bread crumb mixture and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with additional salsa and lime wedges, if desired.
